newsitem.title: USA: U.S. power output rises 2.1 pct vs. year ago -- EEI.
newsitem.headline: U.S. power output rises 2.1 pct vs. year ago -- EEI.

text.p: Electricity deliveries in the continental U.S. totaled 66,257 gigawatt hours (GWh) for the week ended January 25, up 2.1 percent from the same period in 1996, the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) said.
The amount of weekly power supplied to the Southeast region showed the largest gain, up 4.4 percent to 16,467 GWh, EEI said.
The Pacific Northwest experienced the largest decrease in power output, falling 5.2 percent from the corresponding period a year earlier to 3,740 GWh.
Domestic power production for the 52 weeks ended January 25 totaled about 3,313,002 GWh, up 2.0 percent from the same period in 1996, EEI said.
